method: Chronological walk-forward benchmark comparison. Historical bucket frequencies are Laplace-smoothed and shrunk toward training base rate.
scope: Daily spot price direction baseline plus funding-rate feature ablation. Not the production five-layer model.
leakage_controls: Each training label is used only after its target horizon has completed.
Features only use candle/funding observations timestamped no later than forecast time.
No random split; chronological walk-forward evaluation.

benchmark_definitions.base: Training-period up-frequency, smoothed; Brier benchmark correctly labelled.
benchmark_definitions.momentum: Historical up-frequency conditional on 7-day momentum bucket.
benchmark_definitions.ma20: Historical up-frequency conditional on price relative to 20-day moving average.
benchmark_definitions.ma50: Historical up-frequency conditional on price relative to 50-day moving average.
benchmark_definitions.combined: Historical up-frequency conditional on momentum bucket and 20-day moving-average side.
benchmark_definitions.funding_augmented: Combined features plus last funding rate known by forecast time; only scored when funding feature exists.

limitations: Confidence intervals use horizon-length block resampling but remain approximate; overlapping targets can still make inference optimistic.
Trading simulation assumes a single entry at forecast close and exit at horizon close, charges stated round-trip cost, and allows overlapping trades; summed returns are not a portfolio equity curve.
Funding feature is a simple historical ablation, not a full perpetual-futures PnL model; funding cash flows, leverage, liquidation, and margin are not simulated.
No strategy should be considered production-ready without further validation and realistic execution assumptions.
